content: ClickUp form embed uses iframe class clickup-dynamic-height plus forms-embed/v1.js (iFrameResizer 4.2.8, checkOrigin true, postMessage). Form response has no X-Frame-Options, has x-robots-tag noindex, html lang en-US, Angular SPA. Redirect after submit does not work in embeds (open feature request, 72 votes), so no native conversion event. Some ClickUp embeds rely on third-party cookies.
